source.name: Lichess standard rated games (CC0)
source.sampling: Stratified random sample of 520 complete zstd frames of the monthly file (the file is a chain of independent 32 MiB frames, ~14,400 consecutive games each, 3-15 minutes of play): the 29.2 GB file was cut into 520 equal byte strata and one frame was drawn at random (seed 20260924) in each, so the sample spans 2026.09.01 00:00:00 to 2026.09.30 22:40:06 UTC (30 distinct days, every hour of the day) instead of only the first days of the month. Bias: online games by Lichess players, not master or over-the-board data; bullet/ultrabullet/correspondence excluded; one short contiguous window per stratum, so the same players recur and busy hours are over-represented in proportion to traffic; the first and last (cut) game of every frame is dropped; byte-position sampling gives each frame an equal chance (frames are ~equal in games).

bandRule: average of white and black rating
